name: Minimalist Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++ 50gm | Clinically Tested in US (In-Vivo) | Lightweight Cream with Multi-Vitamins | No White Cast | Broad Spectrum Niacinamide Sunscreen For Oily Skin, Dry Skin | For
description:
Type: Lightweight Moisturiser + Sunscreen
SPF: 50
PA Rating: PA++++ (Very High UVA Protection)

Key Features

Lightweight Formula: Feels like a moisturiser, spreads easily & absorbs quickly

Natural Finish: Leaves skin soft, hydrated, and non-shiny

Broad Spectrum Protection: Shields against both UVA & UVB rays

Vitamin-Enriched: Infused with Vitamins A, B, E & F to repair skin and reduce UV damage

Daily Use: Perfect for everyday sun protection without greasiness
